description:
About our brand and products:

August Publishing House is an independent publishing brand focused on bringing readers engaging, story-driven books across multiple genres. Our goal is to create books that are easy to discover, enjoyable to read, and compelling enough to keep readers coming back for more.

We offer digital books and book-related products through our online store, making it simple for readers to explore new stories and continue following the series they love.

What makes us different:

We focus on building long-term reader relationships through strong storytelling, accessible pricing, and series-based content that encourages repeat purchases.

Our books are created for readers who enjoy immersive stories, emotional hooks, and binge-worthy reading experiences. We are also actively growing our publishing catalog, which gives affiliates more opportunities to promote new releases, featured books, and ongoing series.

How affiliates can earn:

Affiliates earn commission by promoting August Publishing House books and sending customers to our store through their unique affiliate link.

When a customer makes a qualifying purchase through an affiliate’s link, the affiliate earns a commission based on the approved commission rate.

Commission payments are released every 30th of the following month. For example, commissions from sales made in June will be released on July 30.

How to promote us:

Affiliates can promote August Publishing House through websites, blogs, email newsletters, social media posts, book recommendation pages, reader communities, YouTube channels, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook groups, and other approved promotional channels.

Affiliates may share book links, recommend specific titles or series, create book-related content, post reviews, feature promotions, or introduce our store to readers who may be interested in discovering new books.

We encourage authentic promotion that focuses on helping readers find books they may genuinely enjoy.

Other information:

Please use your unique affiliate link when promoting our books so your referrals can be tracked properly.

Affiliates should avoid spam, misleading claims, unauthorized paid ads using our brand name, or any promotional method that may damage the reputation of August Publishing House.

We are looking for affiliates who can help us reach real readers and build long-term relationships with book lovers.
